review_candidates.title: Software Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Join ORTEC At ORTEC, we help organizations navigate operational complexity. Through optimization software and decision intelligence expertise, we make work flow. Every day, our software support planners, drivers, nurses, shift workers, and other professionals by transforming complexity into clarity and flow: from fairer schedules to more efficient operations. Our values are more than just words. They shape how we work, how we hire, and how we show up for customers every day. We build trust through honesty and accountability, strengthen our community through collaboration, embrace challenges with grit, explore new possibilities with curiosity, and strive for excellence in everything we do. Your role As a Support Engineer, you will be part of our global Customer Experience Team, which operates within ORTEC’s SaaS Operations Department. This department provides essential support to our customers worldwide and our internal business divisions. Your mission is to ensure an excellent customer experience by analyzing and resolving incidents and requests during the maintenance phase. This role requires strong analytical skills, technical troubleshooting abilities, and a customer-centric attitude. Your team and projects You will become an expert in ORTEC products and provide troubleshooting support across multiple industries. Your work will involve a mix of understanding customer business processes and applying technical expertise to resolve issues effectively. You will be part of a multicultural team working in a 24/7 follow-the-sun model to support global customers. We emphasize collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Our culture values: Teamwork & Support: We work closely, support each other, and share knowledge. Innovation & Growth: We encourage new ideas and constructive feedback. Customer-Centric Approach: We ensure professional and friendly communication with customers. Engagement & Responsibility: We take ownership of our work and strive for excellence. What you will do Key Tasks: Handling Customer Requests: Intake and analyze customer requests, ensuring all necessary information is available for troubleshooting. Monitor and respond to critical alerts to prevent system issues. Manage incidents related to data interfacing between ORTEC solutions and external systems. Troubleshoot application performance issues (e.g., SQL query errors, message queuing). Investigate and explain application results to customers. Technical Support & Maintenance: Diagnose and resolve product configuration issues. Debug SQL queries, manage interfaces (XSLT, web services, scripts), and perform product patching. Conduct standard maintenance activities to ensure optimal system performance. Handle access management requests. Customer Communication: Provide support via ticketing system/phone/MS Teams, maintaining a professional and supportive tone. Ensure timely, high-quality resolutions, balancing customer business needs with technical troubleshooting. Who you are Must-have experience Passion for customer support and ORTEC’s mission. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Adaptability to changing environments and willingness to learn. Ability to work in an international team and handle shifts. Availability to be present in the office 2/3 days a week (every day during the onboarding period). High sense of ownership, responsibility, and organization. Quality-oriented and customer-focused mindset. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. Basic understanding of software systems, SQL, and databases. Using AI tools to complete basic/repetitive tasks. Preferred experience Previous customer support experience. Interest in problem-solving and troubleshooting. GIT/software versioning experience. Education and certifications University degree in a relevant field (preferably IT-related). Languages Fluent in English (multilingual is a plus). Location Based in Rio de Janeiro. What we offer A dynamic, technical, and intellectually stimulating environment. Opportunities for continuous skill development in customer service and technical areas. Exposure to real-world problem-solving in diverse industries, including retail, logistics, healthcare, energy, and more. A unique and inspiring work experience in an open and creative environment. Smart, enthusiastic, and fun colleagues. Work-life balance and flexible scheduling. Career development opportunities, including job rotation and performance-based growth. Hybrid work model-requires presence in the office at least 3 times a week (office in Rio) Relaxation areas and on-site perks. Social and wellness benefits, including medical and dental coverage for you and up to 4 dependents and gym benefits. Home office allowance. Food and Meal vouchers. Optional private pension plan with a company match of up to 4% of your base salary, subject to the applicable vesting rules. Biannual team events (teambuilding, summer party, Christmas party). Performance-based annual bonus (up to one full salary). Interested? Ready to make work flow? Apply through our careers site with your CV and motivation letter and discover what you can contribute at ORTEC. For questions about the role or application process, contact Recruitment@ortec.com Life at ORTEC Join a global community of professionals working across countries, cultures, and disciplines. At ORTEC, you'll collaborate with international colleagues, contribute your unique perspective, and build meaningful connections across teams and borders. In an inclusive and collaborative environment, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and develop your career within an international organization.
